name: aem-block-library trigger queries
description: Should trigger when a finished EDS block needs an entry in the author-facing block library (Experience Workspace / DA library or Sidekick Library): finding the library, page, variants, sheet row, library metadata. Near misses are tests against the library page (testing-blocks), finding real pages (find-test-content), building a block (content-driven-development), content models (content-modeling), authoring page HTML (da-content), local draft pages (aem-cli), the Block Collection, and Universal Editor models (ue-component-model).

queries.query: The `testimonial` block is done. Our authors use Experience Workspace; make sure they can find it and insert it from the editor.
We author in Word with the AEM Sidekick. How do I get the new `accordion` block to show up in the Sidekick Library for authors?
Add the `hero` block with its `dark` and `centered` variants to the block library so authors can see how each looks.
I wrote the library page for `quote` but it doesn't appear in the Blocks panel in the editor. What else do I have to add?
Where does the block library for this project live, and what do I need to create when I ship a new block?
Add a short description to each block in our DA block library so authors know when to use it.
I built a `pricing-table` block. Authors should be able to copy it into a page. Not sure if this project uses the Sidekick Library or the DA library.
What goes in the library tab of the site config so that the Blocks entry shows in Experience Workspace?
I added a `compact` variant to the `cards` block. Update the library so authors can pick it.
Our `tabs` block is built by auto-blocking from sections. How do I show it in the Sidekick Library so authors can copy it?
Write Playwright E2E tests for the `tabs` block that run against its library page.
Which real pages on the site use the `cards` block? I want to audit usage before restyling it.
Build a new `timeline` block with a variant for compact layout. Follow our normal workflow.
Design the content model for a pricing table block that authors edit in Experience Workspace.
Write the HTML for a DA page with a hero, three cards and a footer fragment link.
Make a draft page under ./content/drafts so I can preview my new block on `aem up`.
Is there a ready-made accordion block in the Block Collection I can start from?
Add the Universal Editor component model for the new `promo` block in our xwalk project.
